description_en: Modifies the firewall rule in a firewall template. You can apply the new firewall rule to simple application servers
description_zh: 对于已创建的防火墙模板，您可以根据业务需求修改防火墙规则，并最终将这些规则通过防火墙模板设置到轻量应用服务器实例中
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open modify-firewall-template --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --firewall-template-id ft-bcf1a7hrdq7170000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyFirewallTemplate

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the simple application server. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
指定的轻量应用服务器实例所属的地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查看支持的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the firewall template
parameters.name: firewall_template_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the firewall template
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description of the firewall template
parameters.name: description

fields.help_en: The ID of the firewall rule
fields.name: firewall_template_rule_id

fields.help_en:
The port range. Valid values: 1 to 65535. Specify a port range in the format of \<start port number>/\<end port number>. Example: `1024/1055`, which indicates that the port range of 1024 to 1055.

If you set RuleProtocol to ICMP, you must set Port to -1/-1
fields.help_zh:
端口范围。端口的取值范围为1~65535。使用正斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口，例如：`1024/1055`表示端口范围为1024~1055。

如果您设置的是ICMP协议，端口只能为-1/-1
fields.name: port

fields.help_en: The remarks of the firewall template rule
fields.name: remark

fields.help_en:
The transport layer protocol that the rule supports. Valid values:

TCP

UDP

TCP+UDP

ICMP
fields.help_zh:
传输层协议。可能值：

TCP：TCP协议。
UDP：UDP协议。
TCP+UDP：TCP和UDP协议。
ICMP：ICMP协议
fields.name: rule_protocol

fields.help_en: The source address to which you want to grant access permissions. CIDR blocks and IPv4 addresses are supported
fields.help_zh: 需要设置访问权限的源端IPv4 CIDR地址段。支持CIDR格式和IPv4格式的IP地址范围
fields.name: source_cidr_ip

parameters.help_en: The firewall rule in the template
parameters.name: firewall_template_rule
